title: Mixed Event — At This Festival Bathed in Twilight — Episode5 A Flyer Full Of Our Thoughts

meta.Event: At This Festival Bathed in Twilight
meta.Episode: Episode5 — A Flyer Full Of Our Thoughts
meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu continues to study for her medical school entrance exams while developing some angst towards her mother. However, she ends up volunteering for a big festival called Shibuya Festa and...

rows.Line: Shibuya Festa - Stage Area

rows.Speaker: Man A
rows.Line: Um, are there any vending machines around here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There should be some behind the sign for the entrance to the seating area.

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Excuse me. East Elementary's dance performance hasn't begun yet, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. They'll be performing in ten minutes, so if you don't mind waiting in the seating area.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Quite a few people are here now Hinomori and her group have done their show.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's not too bad at the moment, but I'm sure more will be coming once the general participants begin performing...)

rows.Speaker: Man B
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me.
Can you tell me where they have timetables available?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, they're by the area for advertisements. It's just nearby, so I can show you where it is...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They're right here. Please take whichever ones you need. There's also information regarding each group that will be performing.

rows.Speaker: Man B
rows.Line: Thank you for your assistance. You've been so generous.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah, you're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should head back to the stage...)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Hello! We're Leo/need! We'll be today's first afternoon act!

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: We'll be the first act performing this afternoon! Please stop by to watch if you like!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Wait, that's...
Hoshino, Mochizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We'd love to see you there!
We normally play at live houses!
Oh, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Please stop by if you like.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We're Leo/need!
We'll be today's first afternoon... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello.
Fancy seeing you all here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You also decided to come?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, my teacher asked me to volunteer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You and your band are performing today, aren't you, Hoshino? Are these your bandmates?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm Shiho Hinomori.
It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My sister's told me all about you, Asahina. Thank you for always looking after her during archery club.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, you must be Hinomori's younger sister. I've heard stories about how cute you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, I'm Saki Tenma! I play the keyboard! Hehe. It's really nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, it's nice to meet you as well.
My name is Mafuyu Asahina, and I'm a second-year.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool, Ichi!
I've heard stories about Asahina, but they're all true! You can totally see that she exudes an aura of perfection when you're next to her!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're saying that while literally standing in front of her... But I understand what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Haha... No, I'm hardly what you call perfect.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By the way, what are you handing out? Those look like flyers of some sort...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. We're doing what we can to make sure people remember our names since we get to perform on such a big stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A lot of people end up throwing away flyers and ads, but they do help in terms of getting our name out there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And make it so as many people as possible come hear our songs!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. You all certainly seem to have a plan. It's very impressive. Would you mind if I took one as well?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Here you go!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Did you make this together? It's very well designed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Hona did most of the designing!
I threw in a few illustrations here and there!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You designed this, Mochizuki?
The layout's very nice and easy to follow. This sun's also very cute. It looks like it's full of energy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Th-That's...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona's the one who drew that lion!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, this is a lion?
I apologize for mistaking it for a sun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, that's okay!
If anything, I should be the one apologizing because of how funny it turned out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, actually...
It's very unique and has left a bit of an impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
The thing is...
Until just recently, I was too scared of having others see my drawings. Actually, a part of me still feels afraid...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But your friend, Ena, she was kind enough to teach me, and I did learn to draw a little better...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: At the same time, I was told that my art does seem to leave an impression on others, which could end up being a benefit...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Ena did say the other day that she taught someone Kanade knows how to draw... I didn't realize that she meant Mochizuki.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We want to go pro together, so we're doing everything we can to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because the four of us going pro together is our big dream!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. So let's all do our very best today!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Their big dream...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're willing to face your weaknesses and try to overcome them for the sake of making your dream come true. That's very admirable.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I hope that as many people here get to hear your music as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, we should start heading backstage soon. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Good luck, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Again? What is this...?)

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me.
Can you point me towards where the restrooms are?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
Let me show you. They're right this way.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! This is amazing!
Look at all the stalls!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, they have a shooting gallery over there! Nene, we should go give it a try♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, Emu! Hold on!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. They certainly seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, indeed!
It's only natural to get excited when you're at a festival like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
However, it's not just stalls here...
I'm seeing all these bronze statues and wooden sculptures. That's not something you normally see at these kinds of events.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that may be because Shibuya Festa is partly a celebration of the arts. I remember seeing that there's an art exhibit somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Interesting! They've taken a rather experimental approach to this festival.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, there's even a piano sitting in the middle of the street. I may just have to come back and play something once our show is done!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's a wonderful idea. I'd love to hear you play the piano again, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Let's go get some cotton candy!
Wah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, you shouldn't run like that.
Please make sure to look where you're going.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Oh, um... I'm sorry for running into you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're forgiven.
For saying such a nice apology, here's a little reward.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Wow! It's a balloon puppy!
Can I really have this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
I hope you enjoy the festival, but be careful not to get hurt.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll be careful!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Where did you get that thing from?
Or rather, where were you hiding it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Where indeed?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're back! And got lots of prizes!
Huh? What are you two doing...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmmm... Your pocket full of secrets must be... This one! No, this one?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's no magic or anything to it, really.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you doing...?
Huh? Rui? Is that you...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki?
